intent: A number the person can type, step, and read in their locale, with optional min and max.
useWhen: A quantity, percentage, or other number in a form
The value should format with the locale's grouping and decimal mark
Arrow keys or stepper buttons should move by a step
doNotUseWhen: A rough amount on a track — use Slider

locale.note: BCP 47. Default is the runtime locale.

requirements: Input is role=spinbutton with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuetext
ArrowUp and ArrowDown move by step and clamp to min and max
Blur clamps a typed value to min and max
Stepper buttons are labelled Decrease value and Increase value
Must have a Field label or ariaLabel
built-in labels (decreaseValue, increaseValue) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

doNot: Do not use input type=number when the locale format matters
Do not put a currency symbol on NumberInput — use CurrencyInput
snippet: <Field label="Quantity" htmlFor="qty"><NumberInput id="qty" min={1} max={99} step={1} /></Field>
